scripts.migrate: yes Y | wrangler d1 migrations apply DB
scripts.seed: yes Y | wrangler d1 execute DB --file seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run migrate -- --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.typecheck: npm run cf-typegen && react-router typegen && tsc -b

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Required authentication secret. Generate a unique value with `openssl rand -hex 32` or a 256-bit hexadecimal value at [JWT Secrets](https://jwtsecrets.com/), and keep it unchanged across deployments.

BETTER_AUTH_BASE_URL.description: Public HTTPS origin of this FormZero NG deployment, without a trailing slash.

FORMZERO_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Recommended 32-byte key used to encrypt SMTP, Turnstile, and webhook secrets. Use `openssl rand -hex 32` or the [JWT Secrets Encryption Key Generator](https://jwtsecrets.com/tools/encryption-key-generator) with AES, 256-bit, hexadecimal output. Never rotate it without migrating stored secrets.

FORMZERO_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public HTTPS origin of this FormZero NG deployment, without a trailing slash. Used for links in notifications.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Optional global Cloudflare Turnstile secret key. Leave empty when Turnstile is disabled or configure an encrypted key per form later.

IP_HASH_SECRET.description: Recommended HMAC secret for hashed IP storage and IP-based rate limits. Generate a unique value with `openssl rand -hex 32` or a 256-bit hexadecimal value at [JWT Secrets](https://jwtsecrets.com/).
